args: const pins=[];for(const c of await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAll()){if(!c.getState_SupplierId())continue;const pp=await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(c.getState_PrimitiveId());pins.push({ref:c.getState_Designator(),pins:pp.map(p=>({n:p.getState_PinNumber(),r:p.getState_Rotation(),x:p.getState_X(),y:p.getState_Y()}))});}return pins;
